pin: Only observed GitHub merged_by logins have merge keys. Everyone else cannot merge: a zero as merger is lack of keys, not unused privilege. Non-maintainer 'merge rate' is author-success (a key holder merged their PR). Reviewer/ACK is not merge authority. Roster membership is not the same set as merge keys.

roles.merge_keys: Login appears as GitHub merged_by. Technical ability to land code on bitcoin/bitcoin. The only people who can merge.
roles.roster_without_keys: On the canonical maintainer roster but never appears as merged_by in this dump. Do not cite as unused privilege.
roles.cannot_merge: Not in observed merged_by. They have not merged because they cannot. Reviewer/author/commenter status does not grant keys.
